items.text: This Cookie Policy explains how KomKast Global Technologies LLC ("KomKast", "we", "us" or "our") may use cookies and similar technologies on its website.
It explains what cookies are, why they may be used and how visitors can manage their preferences.
This Policy should be read together with our Privacy Policy.
Cookies are small text files that may be stored on your computer, mobile device or browser when you visit a website.
Cookies and similar technologies can help websites:
Operate correctly.
Maintain security.
Remember visitor preferences.
Understand how visitors use the website.
Improve website performance.
Support website functionality.
Similar technologies may include pixels, tags, scripts, local storage and other tools that store or access information on your device.
Depending on the technologies implemented on our website, cookies may fall into the following categories.
These cookies may be required for the website to function properly.
They can support:
Website security.
Network management.
Basic website functionality.
Form submission.
Other services requested by visitors.
These cookies generally cannot be disabled through website preference controls where they are essential to the service requested.
These cookies may help us understand how visitors interact with our website.
They may provide information about:
Pages visited.
Visitor navigation.
Website usage patterns.
Website performance.
Technical errors.
This information can help us improve the website and visitor experience.
These cookies may remember choices or preferences made by visitors.
For example:
Language preferences.
Display preferences.
Other website settings.
If implemented, these technologies may help measure marketing activity, understand visitor engagement or support relevant advertising.
They may be provided by third-party marketing or advertising services.
Non-essential marketing cookies should only be used where the required consent or other lawful basis has been obtained.
Some website features may be provided by third-party services.
Depending on the services implemented, these providers may place or access cookies or similar technologies.
Examples may include:
Website analytics services.
Embedded video or media.
Meeting or scheduling tools.
Website security services.
Marketing and advertising tools.
Social media integrations.
Third-party providers may process information in accordance with their own privacy policies and terms.
KomKast does not control cookies placed independently by third-party websites when you visit those websites.
Where a cookie preference or consent mechanism is provided, visitors may be able to:
Accept all cookies.
Reject non-essential cookies.
Select specific cookie categories.
Change or withdraw previously given consent.
Strictly necessary cookies may continue to operate where required for website functionality.
You may also manage cookies through your browser settings, including blocking or deleting cookies.
Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality or the availability of some features.
Cookie requirements may vary depending on the visitor's location and applicable law.
Where required, KomKast will seek consent before placing or accessing non-essential cookies or similar technologies.
The website's actual cookie practices and consent mechanism should reflect the technologies in use and the legal requirements applicable to visitors.
We may update this Cookie Policy when our website, technologies, business practices or applicable requirements change.
The latest version will be published on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.
